elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Customer (Company)
elements.evidence: "the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products" — a non-compete/exclusivity restriction on Customer remains

elements.element: Exclusivity scope limited to a defined product category
elements.evidence: "with respect to Deerskin Products" (a defined term), with the open-ended "or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, ... Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar ...)" deleted
"during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date" replacing "during the term of this Agreement"

elements.element: Automatic termination of the exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet service levels
elements.evidence: "shall terminate automatically upon HDI's failure to meet any service level ... under this Agreement"

elements.element: Automatic termination of the exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet delivery dates

reasons: Fallback is fully satisfied: the Company's covenant is now capped at 12 months from the Effective Date, confined to the closed defined category "Deerskin Products", and ends automatically on HDI's failure to meet any service level or delivery date.
Preferred is not met because an exclusivity obligation on the Customer survives; the drafter's locked target was the fallback, so this is acceptable.

Edits are surgical: a duration phrase swap, deletion of the open-ended similar-products/similar-companies extension, and one concise sentence supplying the absent automatic-termination trigger. No whole-clause rewrite or boilerplate added.

Untouched terms remain effective: HDI's exclusive "Deerskin" brand right, the Section 4.1 term/termination mechanics and the Termination Payment are unchanged, and the Section 6.2 carve-out cross-reference still functions. No undefined term or dangling mechanic introduced.
